name: Nimbus Analytics — Internal Workspace
description: A fictitious B2B SaaS company's internal knowledge base. Employees see runbooks and policies; managers add compensation bands and hiring plans; execs see board and roadmap material.

role_hints.employee: onboarding, security policy, runbooks, postmortems, perf review guide
role_hints.manager: adds compensation bands, hiring plan, and compliance audits
role_hints.exec: full corpus including board deck, workforce memo, and roadmaps

empty_state_description: QueryTrace retrieves documents from the Nimbus Analytics internal corpus, filters by role, penalises stale docs, and enforces token budgets — with every decision visible in the Decision Trace. Pick a scenario to see the contrast.

scenarios.title: Permission Wall
scenarios.subtitle: Employee
scenarios.query: What are the engineering compensation bands and salary ranges for senior engineers?
scenarios.hint: An employee asking about salary bands hits 8 documents blocked by RBAC.
scenarios.compare_hint: No Filters surfaces 14 docs · RBAC + Full Pipeline block 8.
scenarios.single_tooltip: Shows what an employee can access — the manager-level comp bands stay blocked
scenarios.compare_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — see how each policy handles employee-level permissions
scenarios.compare_card_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — No Filters surfaces all 14 docs while RBAC and Full Pipeline block 8

scenarios.title: Stale Runbook
scenarios.subtitle: Employee
scenarios.query: What is the current on-call escalation process and database failover procedure?
scenarios.hint: Both runbook versions match — the superseded v1 is freshness-penalized 0.5×.
scenarios.compare_hint: Both versions retrievable · only Full Pipeline demotes the outdated v1 runbook.
scenarios.single_tooltip: Shows the on-call runbooks — the superseded v1 is freshness-penalized
scenarios.compare_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — only Full Pipeline demotes the outdated runbook
scenarios.compare_card_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — only Full Pipeline demotes the outdated runbook

scenarios.title: Roadmap Drift
scenarios.subtitle: Exec
scenarios.query: How did the final FY2025 product roadmap change from the draft version?
scenarios.hint: Full corpus access — the superseded roadmap draft appears but is freshness-penalized 0.5×.
scenarios.compare_hint: Full corpus retrievable · only Full Pipeline demotes the superseded draft 0.5×.
scenarios.single_tooltip: Shows both roadmap versions — the superseded draft is demoted by freshness scoring
scenarios.compare_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — superseded documents get demoted only under Full Pipeline
scenarios.compare_card_tooltip: Opens side-by-side comparison — superseded documents get demoted only under Full Pipeline
